AR-FR60.title: Vicway FR60 433MHz 4-Button Remote
AR-FR60.features:
• Genuine or high-quality compatible replacement
  • Secure rolling code technology
  • Controls up to 4 doors
  • Compact, durable design
  • Battery included
  • Easy programming
  • Australian stock
  • 12-month warranty
AR-FR60.compatibility:
Compatible with the following Vicway systems (original remote must have white buttons):

  • ✅ V-380G (original remote must have white buttons)
  • ✅ V-380LM
  • ✅ V-390G (original remote must have white buttons)
  • ✅ FR46 Remote (must have white buttons)
  • ✅ FR32 Remote
  • ✅ FR42 Remote
  • ✅ V500 Sliding Gate
  • ✅ V600 Swing Gate

Not compatible with: motors installed 2015 and after, or remotes with blue buttons.
AR-FR60.instructions:
📖 Programming Instructions

  1. Press and hold the desired button on your new remote.
  2. Press and release the Learn button on the Vicway opener panel.
  3. Wait for the opener indicator to confirm the code has been learned.
  4. Test the remote operation.

⚠️ Important Information

  • Please check your Vicway opener model before ordering.
  • The appearance of your existing remote does not always determine compatibility.
  • Incorrect model or frequency selection may result in the remote not working.
  • If you're unsure which remote you need, contact our team before purchasing.

AR-RCG02B.title: Gliderol TM27 27MHz 1-Button Remote
AR-RCG02B.features:
• Genuine or high-quality compatible replacement
  • Fixed code dipswitch technology
  • Controls 1 garage door or gate
  • Compact, durable design
  • Battery included
  • Easy programming
  • Australian stock
  • 12-month warranty
AR-RCG02B.compatibility:
Compatible with the following Gliderol systems:

  • ✅ Gliderol TM27 Black
  • ✅ Gliderol GTX2
  • ✅ Gliderol GTX3
  • ✅ Gliderol GTX-M27
  • ✅ Gliderol GTX-M27G
  • ✅ Gliderol GT-27MTX-B
  • ✅ Glidermatic De Luxe

Note: The circuit board must be green. If the board is blue, your remote is the obsolete GTXU1 and requires a receiver upgrade.
AR-RCG02B.instructions:
📖 Programming Instructions

  1. Open the remote and set the 9 dipswitches to match your existing remote or opener.
  2. Ensure the dipswitch positions match exactly.
  3. Test the remote operation.
